items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: I like the music that, what you call them, Lawrence Webb play, you know, music like that.

ctx.x: What kind of music do you like?

I like the music that, what you call them, Lawrence Webb play, you know, music like that. But the other music, that's why I don't fool those boys now. Because for dances, when they give dance for school, I would go with them. But the music they play and you see, I just can't put up with that. You don't like rock and roll? No, I don't like it. I just don't like it. And that's what you have to put it there. I don't like it. I don't find nothing in it myself. I don't know, do they write music for that? I don't…
I don't think. I think they just stand up and play.
